summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Glovo Algeciras delivery application. Backend APIs are fully functional (100% success rate). Frontend testing shows good core functionality with some minor UI issues in custom Select components.

ui_bugs.issue: Custom Select component dropdown options not clickable - vehicle type selection fails
Dialog overlay intercepts pointer events preventing dropdown option selection
ui_bugs.impact: Makes business creation form difficult to complete

design_issues.issue: Missing aria-describedby attributes for DialogContent components
Placeholder images (via.placeholder.com) fail to load due to DNS resolution
design_issues.impact: Images not displaying, but functionality works

passed_tests: All backend API endpoints (30/30 tests passed)
Authentication flows for all 3 user roles
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix custom Select component interactions: 1) Vehicle type dropdown in driver registration not allowing option selection, 2) Business category dropdown in business creation has overlay interference. These are likely z-index or event handling issues with the custom Select components. Also consider adding aria-describedby attributes to Dialog components for better accessibility.
